loc_explain: To find the nearest blood bank, allow location.
loc_using: Using your phone's location. Type an area to search somewhere else.
loc_type: Tap “Use my location”, or type an area.
loc_denied: Location is off. Type your area instead.
loc_failed: Couldn't get your location. Type your area instead.
speak_hint: Or tap once to start, and tap again to send.
rec_hint_hold: Speak now. Slide left to cancel.
rec_hint_tap: Speak now. Tap the button again to send.
heard_check: We're not sure about the marked items. Tap one to change it.
clarify_group: Which blood group do you need?
clarify_other: Use the form above to answer, then tap Search.
donors_asked_one: We asked {n} donor. We'll show their reply in My requests.
donors_asked_other: We asked {n} donors. We'll show their replies in My requests.
none_title_any: No blood banks with stock within {km} km.
em_intro: If the patient is in danger, call now.
err_mic_denied: Microphone is off. Allow it in settings, or type your request.
err_mic_none: We couldn't use the microphone. You can still fill the form and tap Search.
err_no_voice: Voice isn't available in this browser. Fill the form and tap Search.
err_too_short: That was too short. Hold the button and speak.
err_offline: No connection. Your request is saved and will send when you're back online.
err_network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
err_timeout: This is taking too long. Please try again.
err_rate: You've made many requests. Please wait, or call 104.
err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again, or call 104.
donate_intro: When blood banks near you run out, we ask willing donors. We only share your number if you agree, every time.
fact_private: Seekers never see your exact location
area_note: We use your area to match nearby requests. It is never shown to anyone.
sex_note: Only used to work out when you can donate again.
consent: I agree to be asked when someone near me needs blood. My number is shared only if I say yes.
donor_verify_note: We'll check your phone number with a one-time code before saving.
err_donor_place: Use your location or type your area.
err_donor_checks: Please confirm all three to register.
donor_available: Available · you'll get at most 2 requests a day
donor_resting_plain: Resting · not eligible to donate yet
requests_empty: Your requests appear here for 24 hours.
requests_signin: Sign in to see your requests.
lang_note: This changes the app's text. Replies are spoken in the language you speak.
signin_why: We use your phone number to keep your requests and donor details private.
demo_code_note: In demo mode the code is printed in the server console.
err_code: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
err_code_many: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
